request.subject: ICON:ACTION:BUILD_BARRICADE

layers.text: Redraw it as a different object in the same style: a short sturdy barricade of four sharpened wooden stakes standing side by side, pale tan wood with dark brown grain, points up, alternately tall and short, bound together across the middle by one bright copper band with round rivets, their feet driven into a small heap of dark brown earth. Nothing else: no rotor, no bomb, no face. Thick black outline, flat colours, on a transparent background.
